description: Declarative training-failure signatures. A signature is supported when every required condition holds and no contradicting condition holds. Conditions marked needs_reference are evaluated only when a healthy reference run is supplied; without one they leave the verdict pending (missing_reference=pending, the default) or are skipped as corroboration (missing_reference=ignore).

max_adamw_finetune_learning_rate.source: Heuristic upper end of typical AdamW learning rates for fine-tuning pretrained vision backbones (roughly 1e-5 to 1e-3). Not calibrated on RunSleuth runs.

min_learning_rate_ratio_to_reference.source: Order-of-magnitude rule for a learning rate far above a known-good reference. Not calibrated on RunSleuth runs.

max_same_distribution_std_ratio.source: Heuristic stated before the ViT runs: inputs of splits drawn from one distribution and passed through one pipeline should have per-channel standard deviations within 1.5x. Not calibrated on RunSleuth runs.

max_same_distribution_mean_shift.source: Heuristic stated before the ViT runs: per-channel input means of same-distribution splits should differ by less than half a training standard deviation. Not calibrated on RunSleuth runs.

signatures.description: The optimizer still holds replaced head parameters: the current head receives gradients but is never updated, while the backbone trains.

requires.meaning: every current head tensor has a gradient at every step
the head is never updated
current head tensors are absent from the optimizer
the backbone updates in every epoch

contradicts.meaning: a head tensor is not trainable

repair.description: Construct the optimizer from model.parameters() after the head has been replaced.

signatures.description: The classification head has requires_grad=False although full-model training is intended: it receives no gradients and never changes while the backbone trains.

requires.meaning: no head tensor is trainable
no head tensor ever has a gradient
the head is never updated
the backbone updates in every epoch
the healthy reference trains its head, so freezing is unintended

contradicts.meaning: trainable tensors are missing from the optimizer

repair.description: Set requires_grad=True on the head; the optimizer already contains its tensors.

signatures.description: The learning rate is far too high for fine-tuning. For Adam-family optimizers the first update moves each element by about the learning rate, so the effective learning rate is inferred from telemetry rather than read from the config.

requires.meaning: the first-step inference assumes an Adam-family optimizer
the inferred first-step learning rate exceeds the fine-tuning range
the inferred learning rate is at least ten times the reference's

repair.description: Restore the reference learning rate; without a reference, lower it into the fine-tuning range.

signatures.description: Forward and backward passes run but optimizer.step() is never called: gradients exist and no parameter changes.

requires.meaning: training forwards run without any optimizer step
backward still produces gradients
no parameter changes

repair.description: Call optimizer.step() after backward in every training iteration.

signatures.description: Training and evaluation preprocess inputs differently, so the model is evaluated on inputs whose statistics differ from those it was trained on, although the splits come from the same distribution.

any_of.meaning: per-channel input spread differs between training and a same-distribution evaluation split
per-channel input means differ between training and a same-distribution evaluation split

repair.description: Use one preprocessing pipeline, including normalization mean and std, for training and evaluation.

signatures.description: The classification head has more outputs than the task has label classes, for example a pretrained 1000-class ImageNet head kept for a 2-class task; training still runs.

requires.meaning: the training labels contain at least two classes
the head has outputs that no training label uses

repair.description: Load the model with num_labels set to the task's class count so a correctly sized head is created.

signatures.description: Part of the backbone has requires_grad=False although full fine-tuning is intended: those tensors receive no gradients while the rest of the backbone and the head train.

requires.meaning: some backbone tensors are never trainable
some backbone tensors never receive gradients
the rest of the backbone updates
the head updates
the healthy reference trains its whole backbone, so freezing is unintended

contradicts.meaning: the head is frozen too (see frozen_head)

repair.description: Set requires_grad=True on the frozen backbone module before training.
